args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money documented banker's rounding but implemented ROUND_HALF_UP,
causing test_money.py to fail in the nightly build. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as the tests expect.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of payments-service failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching its existing docstring and the FIN-212 requirement (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).
